审题.题型: 命题作文（标题 + 参考陈述）：人们正在对科技上瘾吗？
任务: 把题目给的标题 Are people becoming addicted to technology? 写在正文上方
开头用自己的话转述参考陈述（研究称科技成瘾真实存在，对大脑的影响和毒瘾一样）
直接回答标题的问题，亮明观点：是，许多人正在对科技上瘾
用常见的现象和原因支撑观点：上瘾有哪些表现、为什么会上瘾
提出对策或给出平衡的看法，最后回扣标题
审题.语气: 客观、理性的议论语气：论证用 many people、students 这类第三人称，提对策时用 we should，把自己也包括进去；不夸张、不说教，用身边的具体现象说话
审题.字数: 120—180 词（题目要求 at least 120 words but no more than 180 words）；标题不计入字数，本篇正文 169 词。写到 160—180 词最稳，绝不能超过 180 词
易错: 标题照抄题目，写在正文上方，保留问号：Are people becoming addicted to technology?
参考陈述只能改写，不能照抄：Numerous studies claim that addiction to technology is real … 原样抄进开头会被看作没有自己的语言
标题是一个问句，正文一开头就要明确回答（本篇：many people today are indeed becoming addicted），不能写到最后还没表态
不要写成“科技的利与弊”：题目问的是“是否上瘾”，重点是上瘾的表现、原因和怎么办
be addicted to 的 to 是介词，后接名词或动名词：addicted to technology、addicted to playing games

要求.原句: Are people becoming addicted to technology?
要求.说明: 标题一字不差照抄题目，保留问号，不计入字数。

要求.要求: 用自己的话转述参考陈述
要求.原句: Some researchers warn that heavy use of technology can affect the brain much as drugs do.
要求.说明: 参考陈述是 Numerous studies claim that … the same effect on the brain as drug addiction；范文换成 Some researchers warn that、heavy use of technology、much as drugs do，意思不变，说法全换了。

要求.原句: many people today are indeed becoming addicted to technology
要求.说明: 第一段第二句就明确回答：是的，许多人确实正在对科技上瘾，用 indeed 加强语气，直接呼应标题。

要求.原句: Signs of this addiction are everywhere.
要求.说明: 第二段先总起，再写三个人人都见过的场景：地铁上盯手机、吃饭时看消息、深夜刷短视频、离了手机就焦虑。

要求.原句: One reason for this is that apps are designed to keep users hooked with endless updates, likes and notifications, which give people constant small rewards.
要求.说明: 现象之后说原因：应用程序的设计本来就是让人停不下来，不断给人小小的奖赏，回应了参考陈述里“和毒瘾一样”的说法。

要求.原句: However, technology is not the enemy; the real problem is our lack of self-control.
要求.说明: 第三段用 However 转折：问题不在科技本身，而在自制力，观点更全面，避免一味否定科技。

要求.原句: Only when we stay in control can technology truly serve us.
要求.说明: 先给出三条具体做法（限制屏幕时间、关闭通知、多参加现实活动），最后用 Only when … can … 收尾：保持掌控，科技才能为我们服务，回扣“上瘾”的话题。

要求.原句: Signs of this addiction are everywhere.
要求.说明: 正文共 169 词（标题不计）：第一段 2 句，第二段 5 句，第三段 3 句，现象和原因占篇幅最多，没有超过 180 词。

思路.内容: Are people becoming addicted to technology?（人们正在对科技上瘾吗？），写在正文上方

思路.作用: 转述参考陈述，回答标题
思路.内容: 研究者警告：过度使用科技对大脑的影响像毒品 → 环顾四周，很难不同意：许多人确实正在对科技上瘾
总起：上瘾的迹象随处可见 → 地铁上人人盯手机 → 吃饭时朋友各看消息 → 学生深夜刷短视频，离了手机就焦虑 → 原因：应用程序用没完没了的更新、点赞、通知让人欲罢不能
科技不是敌人，问题在于缺乏自制力 → 限制屏幕时间、关闭不必要的通知、多参加现实活动 → 只有保持掌控，科技才能真正为我们服务

步骤.做法: 把题目给的标题原样写在正文上方，保留问号，抄完逐词核对一遍。
把 Numerous studies claim 换成 Some researchers warn，把 addiction to technology 换成 heavy use of technology，把 the same effect … as drug addiction 换成 much as drugs do，意思不变，说法全换。
用 When we look around, it is hard to disagree: 引出观点，冒号后面直接回答标题：many people today are indeed becoming addicted to technology.

步骤.标题: 总起后写三个日常场景
步骤.做法: 先用 Signs of this addiction are everywhere. 总起；再用 On the subway、At dinner、Many students 写三个具体场景，用现在进行时和 instead of、whenever 写出上瘾的样子。
用 One reason for this is that … 说原因：apps are designed to keep users hooked；再用 which 从句补充 constant small rewards，说明为什么会像毒瘾一样停不下来。
第三段用 However 转折，用分号连接两层意思：technology is not the enemy; the real problem is our lack of self-control.

步骤.标题: 给出对策，用倒装句收尾
步骤.做法: 用 To avoid becoming slaves to technology, we should … 列出三条具体做法；最后用 Only when we stay in control can technology truly serve us. 收尾，倒装句有力。

句式.名称: Some researchers warn that … much as … do 转述句
句式.表达: 表达“一些研究者警告说，……会像……一样……”，用自己的话转述参考陈述
句式.公式: Some researchers warn / Studies show that + 主语 + can + 动词 + 宾语 + much as + 名词 + do
句式.原句: Some researchers warn that heavy use of technology can affect the brain much as drugs do
句式.原句译: 一些研究者警告说，过度使用科技对大脑的影响和毒品很相似
句式.讲解: warn that 意思是“警告说”，比 claim 更能显出这件事的严重性；heavy use of 意思是“过度使用”；much as drugs do 意思是“和毒品（影响大脑）的方式很相似”，do 代替前面的 affect the brain。命题作文的参考陈述只能这样改写，不能照抄。

例句.en: Some doctors warn that sitting for long hours can harm our health much as smoking does.
例句.zh: 一些医生警告说，久坐对健康的危害和吸烟很相似。

例句.en: Some experts warn that fast food can affect children’s weight much as sugary drinks do.
例句.zh: 一些专家警告说，快餐对孩子体重的影响和含糖饮料很相似。

句式.名称: it is hard to disagree: 亮明观点句
句式.表达: 表达“环顾四周，我们很难不同意：……”，承接参考陈述，引出自己的观点
句式.公式: When we look around, it is hard to disagree: + 观点句
句式.原句: When we look around, it is hard to disagree: many people today are indeed becoming addicted to technology
句式.原句译: 环顾四周，我们很难不同意：如今许多人确实正在对科技上瘾
句式.讲解: When we look around 从身边的观察出发，主语是 we，不写 Looking around, it is …（悬垂结构，总论语法扣分点）；it is hard to disagree 表示同意上一句的说法；冒号后面直接给出观点，indeed 意思是“确实”，加强语气。标题问“是不是”，这一句就明确回答了“是”。

例句.en: When we look around, it is hard to disagree: young people today are spending too much time online.
例句.zh: 环顾四周，我们很难不同意：如今的年轻人上网的时间太长了。

例句.en: When we look at the facts, it is hard to disagree: reading habits are changing quickly.
例句.zh: 看看事实，我们很难不同意：人们的阅读习惯正在迅速改变。

替换.en: I fully agree with this view.

句式.名称: do A instead of doing B 对比场景句
句式.表达: 表达“人们做 A，而不是做 B”，用对比写出一种不正常的现象
句式.公式: 地点 / 时间状语, 主语 + 动词 A … instead of + 动名词 B …
句式.原句: friends check their messages instead of talking to each other
句式.原句译: 朋友们各自看手机消息，而不是互相交谈
句式.讲解: instead of 后接动名词（talking），表示“本该做的事却没做”；吃饭时本该聊天，却在看手机，一对比，上瘾的现象就很鲜明。句首的 At dinner 和上一句的 On the subway 都是场景状语，三个场景排列整齐。

例句.en: In class, some students play games on their phones instead of listening to the teacher.
例句.zh: 课堂上，一些学生玩手机游戏，而不是听老师讲课。

例句.en: On weekends, many children watch videos at home instead of playing outdoors.
例句.zh: 周末，许多孩子在家看视频，而不是去户外玩耍。

句式.名称: One reason for this is that 原因句
句式.表达: 表达“造成这种情况的一个原因是……”，在描述现象之后分析原因
句式.公式: One reason for this is that + 主语 + are designed to + 动词原形 …, which …
句式.原句: One reason for this is that apps are designed to keep users hooked with endless updates, likes and notifications
句式.原句译: 原因之一是，应用程序的设计就是用没完没了的更新、点赞和通知让用户欲罢不能
句式.讲解: One reason for this is that 是分析原因最常用的句式，this 指上面的现象，that 后面接完整的句子；be designed to 意思是“被设计来……”；keep users hooked 意思是“让用户上钩、停不下来”，hooked 形象生动；with 后面列出三种具体手段。

例句.en: One reason for this is that online shopping is fast and easy.
例句.zh: 原因之一是，网上购物又快又方便。

例句.en: One reason for this is that many students do not get enough sleep.
例句.zh: 原因之一是，许多学生睡眠不足。

句式.名称: A is not …; the real problem is … 转折观点句
句式.表达: 表达“A 并不是……；真正的问题在于……”，纠正一种片面的看法，给出更深入的观点
句式.公式: However, A is not the enemy / the cause; the real problem is + 名词
句式.原句: However, technology is not the enemy; the real problem is our lack of self-control
句式.原句译: 然而，科技并不是敌人；真正的问题在于我们缺乏自制力
句式.讲解: However 转折，先否定“科技是坏东西”的看法，再用分号连接真正的问题；分号连接两个意思紧密的句子，比用 and 更有力。lack of self-control 意思是“缺乏自制力”。这一句让文章不只是批评科技，观点更全面、更深入。

例句.en: However, video games are not the enemy; the real problem is spending too much time on them.
例句.zh: 然而，电子游戏并不是敌人；真正的问题在于花在上面的时间太多。

例句.en: However, money is not the problem; the real problem is how we use it.
例句.zh: 然而，钱并不是问题；真正的问题在于我们如何使用它。

替换.en: The problem lies not in … but in …

句式.名称: To avoid …, we should 对策句
句式.表达: 表达“为了避免……，我们应该做 A、B 和 C”，一句话提出几条具体对策
句式.公式: To avoid + 动名词 …, we should + 动词1 …, 动词2 … and 动词3 …
句式.原句: To avoid becoming slaves to technology, we should set limits on our screen time, turn off unnecessary notifications and spend more time on real-world activities
句式.原句译: 为了避免沦为科技的奴隶，我们应该限制屏幕使用时间，关闭不必要的通知，并多花时间参加现实生活中的活动
句式.讲解: To avoid 后面接动名词（becoming），放句首说明目的；become slaves to technology 意思是“沦为科技的奴隶”，比喻生动；we should 后面接三个并列的动词短语，每一条都具体可做，第二条 turn off unnecessary notifications 正好对着上文的原因。

例句.en: To avoid wasting food, we should order only what we can eat and take leftovers home.
例句.zh: 为了避免浪费食物，我们应该吃多少点多少，并把剩菜打包带回家。

例句.en: To avoid feeling stressed, we should plan our time well, exercise regularly and get enough sleep.
例句.zh: 为了避免感到压力大，我们应该合理安排时间、经常锻炼、保证睡眠。

替换.en: It is necessary for us to …
Several measures can be taken. First, …
替换.zh: 可以采取几项措施。第一，……

句式.名称: Only when … can … 倒装收尾句
句式.表达: 表达“只有……，才能……”，强调条件，用来有力地收尾
句式.公式: Only when + 主语 + 谓语 … + can + 主语 + 动词原形 …（主句倒装）
句式.原句: Only when we stay in control can technology truly serve us
句式.原句译: 只有我们保持掌控，科技才能真正为我们服务
句式.讲解: Only when 放句首时，后面的主句要倒装：把 can 提到主语 technology 前面（can technology truly serve us），when 从句本身不倒装。stay in control 意思是“保持掌控”，和上文的 slaves 对比。倒装句强调条件，读起来有力，是很好的结尾句。

例句.en: Only when we work together can we protect our environment.
例句.zh: 只有我们齐心协力，才能保护我们的环境。

例句.en: Only when students manage their time well can they balance study and rest.
例句.zh: 只有学生管理好时间，才能兼顾学习和休息。

默写.句式: Some researchers warn that … much as … do 转述句
默写.意义: 改写参考陈述的示范，命题作文开头不能照抄。

默写.句式: it is hard to disagree: 亮明观点句
默写.意义: 承接参考陈述、直接回答标题的好句。

挖空: instead of talking to each other
默写.句式: do A instead of doing B 对比场景句
默写.意义: 用对比写出不正常现象的模板。

挖空: One reason for this is that
are designed to keep users hooked
默写.句式: One reason for this is that 原因句
默写.意义: 描述现象之后分析原因的万能句。

默写.句式: A is not …; the real problem is … 转折观点句
默写.意义: 纠正片面看法、让观点更深入的高分句。

挖空: To avoid becoming slaves to technology
set limits on our screen time
默写.句式: To avoid …, we should 对策句
默写.意义: 一句话提出三条具体对策。

挖空: Only when we stay in control
默写.句式: Only when … can … 倒装收尾句
默写.意义: 倒装句收尾，强调条件，结尾有力。

得分.说明: 紧扣标题的问题：开头用自己的话转述参考陈述，紧接着明确回答“是，许多人确实正在对科技上瘾”；第二段用三个日常场景证明上瘾的存在，再说原因；第三段给出平衡的看法和对策，结尾仍落在“不被科技控制”上。全文没有写成“科技的利与弊”，每一句都在回答标题，符合满分档“切题、观点明确”的要求。
引用: Are people becoming addicted to technology?
Some researchers warn that heavy use of technology can affect the brain much as drugs do.
many people today are indeed becoming addicted to technology
Signs of this addiction are everywhere.
One reason for this is that apps are designed to keep users hooked
Only when we stay in control can technology truly serve us.

得分.说明: 命题作文的标准三段式：转述 + 观点 → 现象 + 原因 → 转折 + 对策。第二段先用 Signs of this addiction are everywhere. 总起，再用 On the subway、At dinner、Many students 三个场景平行展开，One reason for this 从现象过渡到原因；第三段用 However 转折，To avoid … 引出对策，Only when … 收尾。this addiction、this 等词回指上文，衔接紧密，这是满分档在结构上的表现。
引用: When we look around
Signs of this addiction are everywhere.
On the subway
At dinner
One reason for this is that
However
To avoid becoming slaves to technology

得分.说明: 句式丰富：much as drugs do 的比较、冒号引出观点、instead of 的对比、whenever 从句、which 定语从句、分号连接、To avoid 目的状语、Only when 倒装。用词生动准确，如 staring at a phone screen、scroll through short videos、out of reach、keep users hooked、slaves to technology、self-control。全文没有语法错误，语言准确又地道，符合满分档的要求。
引用: much as drugs do
almost everyone is staring at a phone screen
scroll through short videos late into the night
feel anxious whenever their phones are out of reach
keep users hooked with endless updates, likes and notifications
technology is not the enemy; the real problem is our lack of self-control
Only when we stay in control can technology truly serve us.

升格.原句: Some researchers warn that heavy use of technology can affect the brain much as drugs do.

步骤.写法: Numerous studies claim that addiction to technology is real and it has the same effect on the brain as drug addiction.
步骤.说明: 这是参考陈述的原句，照抄进开头，阅卷老师会认为没有自己的语言。

步骤.写法: Many studies say that technology addiction has the same effect on the brain as drug addiction.
步骤.说明: 换了几个词（Many studies say），但句子结构和参考陈述几乎一样，还是像在抄。

步骤.写法: Some researchers warn that heavy use of technology can affect the brain like drugs.
步骤.说明: 主语换成 Some researchers，动词换成 warn，heavy use of technology 换了说法，结构也变了；最后把 like drugs 改成 much as drugs do，比较的是“影响大脑的方式”，表达更准确。

升格.原句: One reason for this is that apps are designed to keep users hooked with endless updates, likes and notifications, which give people constant small rewards.

步骤.写法: The reason is that phones are very interesting.
步骤.说明: 原因太表面，interesting 说不清为什么让人停不下来。

步骤.写法: One reason for this is that apps are designed to keep users hooked.
步骤.说明: 用 One reason for this is that 分析原因，指出是应用程序的设计让人上瘾；keep users hooked 形象地写出“停不下来”。

步骤.写法: One reason for this is that apps are designed to keep users hooked with endless updates, likes and notifications.
步骤.说明: 用 with 列出三种具体手段，原因有了细节；最后再加 which give people constant small rewards，说出为什么这些手段管用，正好呼应参考陈述的“像毒瘾一样”。

升格.原句: Only when we stay in control can technology truly serve us.

步骤.写法: We should use technology in a right way.
步骤.说明: 结尾是一句空话，in a right way 不地道（应为 in the right way），也没有力量。

步骤.写法: If we control ourselves, technology will serve us.
步骤.说明: 说出了条件和结果，和上文的“自制力”相连；但句子平淡，强调不够。

步骤.写法: Only when we control ourselves can technology serve us.
步骤.说明: 用 Only when … can … 倒装强调条件，语气有力；最后把 control ourselves 改成 stay in control，和上文的 slaves to technology 形成对比，再加 truly，结尾更有分量。
